title: Noise-model verification — reference sensor
notes: Runner's module-level verification sensor. GUI baseline widens the ADC to 21 bits (from 14) so the bright MWIR signal (~1.6 Me-) fits the ADC range instead of clipping; gain stays 1.0 e-/DN, so every verified noise term — quantization = gain/sqrt(12) = 0.289 e- included — is bit-identical to the runner (CU-170).
